label: rem:q-holography-two-regime-prior-art
title: Prior art: $q$-Ward identities with separate unit-circle and real-$q$ solutions
html:
Belaey, Mertens and Papalini solve the q-Ward identities for the two-point function on the quantum disk [belaey2025, \S 2.1, pp. 7--8]. The solution depends on the range of q. For q = e^{i\pi b} on the unit circle it is the analytic continuation of their eq. (2.19) to non-integer weight; for 0 < q < 1 it is a convergent infinite product. In both regimes the correlator shows q-deformed hyperbolic disk isometries.

This is an external case, alongside the comparison with canonical programmes, of one q-symmetry having different solutions on the unit circle and on the real line, which is also how QOU separates root-of-unity and real-q evaluations. It is a structural parallel only. The paper's real range is 0 < q < 1, not q_0 > 1, and its b is not checked against the b of the Faddeev quantum dilogarithm used in the corpus, so it is not evidence for any QOU identification.
